posts.body:
I've been using the Yanfly FootstepSounds plugin for a while now and have had an odd experience on some maps with it but I can't seem to pinpoint what's causing the issue.
DEMONSTRATION OF ISSUE
Basically for some reason the tiles I highlighted in red play the Region 3 SE instead of the Region 2/18 SE.
Regardless of what Region I change the Region 3 tiles to, the highlighted tiles will always play the SE of the tiles of the Region I changed the Region 3 tiles to... HOWEVER this doesn't always apply for some reason, as most of the Region 2 tiles function correctly even some located near the Region 3 tiles.
Issues with Yanfly's FootstepsSounds plugin
The isse I'm having with this puglin is that sometimes, apparently random tiles are making the wrong sound when you step on it or not making any sound at all. I say they are "random tiles" because I can't find a pattern to it, but on every map the faulty tiles are always the same. I pretty sure...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
This person had a similar issue to me and I don't really see a solution. My entire game is already mapped out with footstep sound regions but only a very limited number of tiles on a couple maps are causing issues...every other one works just fine.
(It MIGHT be tied to 1 tile thick regions as far as I can tell, but it's awkward to replicate.)
Any help would be appreciated, I hope I provided enough information... I don't feel the need to list off other things I am using since this plugin functions properly in almost every other map.

posts.body:
I agree with you.
I think the direction check is there because the plugin hooks increaseSteps to play sound.
And increaseSteps is executed after the character is about to take a step forward.
That is the reason it uses the tile in font of the character (or the author thinks it should).
But the logic is incorrect because the position of the character will change the moment the step is taken. For example, if the character is at (1,1) and moves downward, its position will be (1,2) before the walk animation plays.
